Question 11

The number of people N infected by a particular virus increases with time. The rate of change of the number of infected people is proportional to the square of the number of infected people. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the number of people infected by the virus at time t?

a
 dNdt=kN2,k>0
b
 dNdt=kN2,k>0
c
 dNdt=−kN,k>0
d
 dNdt=kN,k>0
e
 dNdt=−kN2,k>0
